div.head: Ger 9
div.ab: [9] Me mæig in Maio 7 Iunio 7 Iulio on sumera fealgian, myxendincgan ut dragan, lochyrdla tilian, sceap scyran, bytlian, boteatan, tynan, tymbrian, wudian, weodian, faldian, fiscwer 7 milne macian;

Me mæig inmaio 7 iun. 7 iulio onsume|ra fealgian . myxendincgan ut dra|gan. Lochyrdla tilian . sceap scyran . byt|lian . boteatan . tynan . tymbrian . wu|dian . weodian . faldian . fiscwer . 7 myl|ne macian.
He mæig in Maio and Iunio and Iulio on sumera fealgian, myxendincgan ut dragan, lochyrdla tilian, sceap scyran, bytlian, boteatan, tynan, tymbrian, wudian, weodian, faldian, fiscwer and mylne macian.

Man kann im Mai und Juni und Juli im Sommer [Acker] felgen, Mistdung herausziehen, Hürden herstellen, Schafe scheeren, bauen, ausbessern, zäunen, bauen [zimmern], Holz schneiden, Unkraut jäten, Hürden bauen, Fischwehr und [Wasser-]Mühle machen;

In May and June and July, in summer, one can harrow [fallow land], carry out dung, make hurdles, shear sheep, build, repair, fence, build [in timber], cut wood, weed, make folds, make a fish-weir and a [water-]mill;

One should in May and June and July during the summer [set land] to fallow, take out dung [from] the manure pile, build hurdles for the sheep folds, shear sheep, build, repair, set hedges, build, cut wood, weed, construct sheepfolds and make fish weirs and mills.

In May, June, and July over the summer, one must plow the fields, spread the manure from the dung pile, prepare fences for the sheepfolds, shear the sheep, build, repair, enclose, construct, chop wood, weed, erect the sheepfolds, and make fish weirs and mills.
div.note: K: ‘Iunio 7’ supplied from Liebermann (June had dropped out); ‘bytlian.’ corrected to ‘bytlian,’. ‘Me’ for ‘man’ is attested in the 12th century (Mätzner). ‘myxendincgan’ has -n declension, as Rect 14. ‘boteatan’: compare Napier, Pogatscher. Liebermann compares Rect 2, 4.1a, and Gerefa 16.
